name: Birth Certificate Registration & Application
description: Complete guide to registering a birth and obtaining a birth certificate online or offline with verified statutory fees, timelines, and 2023 amendment rules.

national.title: How to Apply for a Birth Certificate in India (2026)
national.summary: Step-by-step guide to registering a birth and obtaining an official birth certificate on the Civil Registration System portal. Verified statutory fee rules under the RBD Act, delayed registration steps, and document checklist.

steps.title: Institutional Birth Intimation by Hospital to Registrar
steps.description: For hospital births, the hospital sends Form 1 directly to the local Registrar of Births and Deaths within 21 days.
steps.calloutText: Birth registration within 21 days of birth is 100% free of charge under Section 13 of the RBD Act.

steps.title: Create Account on Civil Registration System (crsorgi.gov.in)
steps.description: Sign up on crsorgi.gov.in or your municipal portal using your mobile number and email address to apply online.
steps.where: Official CRS Portal (crsorgi.gov.in) or State Portal

steps.title: Enter Child, Place, and Date of Birth Details
steps.description: Select date of birth, gender, child name (optional at birth), place of birth (hospital or home), and attending doctor.
steps.calloutText: Under Section 14, you can register birth without a name and add the child's name within one year free of cost.

steps.title: Enter Father's and Mother's Details with Aadhaar
steps.description: Enter full legal names, education, occupation, and 12-digit Aadhaar numbers of both father and mother.

steps.title: Fill Address at Time of Birth and Permanent Address
steps.description: Enter the complete residential address where the mother was staying when the child was born and permanent address.

steps.title: Upload Hospital Discharge Slip and Identity Proofs
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of the hospital discharge summary and parents' Aadhaar cards in PDF format under 2 MB.
steps.calloutText: Ensure the date of birth on the discharge slip matches your entered date down to the exact minute.

steps.title: Pay Delayed Registration Fee (If Reported After 21 Days)
steps.description: Birth registration within 21 days is free. If applying after 21 days, pay the nominal statutory delayed fee of ₹2 to ₹20.

steps.title: Download Digitally Signed Certificate or Collect from Registrar
steps.description: Download the digitally signed QR-coded birth certificate from the portal or collect the physical embossed copy from the Registrar.
steps.where: CRS Portal / Municipal Civic Centre Counter

documentRequirements.name: Hospital Discharge Summary / Form 1 Birth Slip
documentRequirements.description: Official institutional birth report slip issued and stamped by the delivering government or private hospital.

documentRequirements.name: Aadhaar Cards of Both Parents
documentRequirements.description: Identity and address proof of both father and mother with 12-digit Aadhaar numbers.

documentRequirements.name: Parents' Marriage Certificate
documentRequirements.description: Official registered marriage certificate required for home births or non-institutional birth verification.

documentRequirements.name: Notarized Delay Affidavit by Parents (30 Days to 1 Year)
documentRequirements.description: Affidavit executed before a notary public stating the exact cause of delay in birth registration.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Original notarized affidavit on stamp paper

documentRequirements.name: Order of Executive Magistrate / SDM (Delayed Over 1 Year)
documentRequirements.description: Statutory magisterial order passed under Section 13(3) of the RBD Act after police inquiry for registration beyond one year.

rejectionReasons.title: Name Spelling Mismatch on Parents' Documents
rejectionReasons.description: Discrepancy between father's or mother's name on hospital records versus official Aadhaar cards causes registry rejection.
rejectionReasons.solution: Ensure the hospital records exact legal spellings from parents' Aadhaar cards at the time of delivery.

rejectionReasons.title: Submitting After 1 Year Without Magistrate Order
rejectionReasons.description: Attempting to register a birth after one year without an order from the Executive Magistrate violates Section 13(3).
rejectionReasons.solution: File an application before the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) to obtain the statutory verification order.

rejectionReasons.title: Unregistered Home Birth Without Village Sarpanch Intimation
rejectionReasons.description: A birth occurring at home without intimation to the local Asha worker, ANM, or village head cannot be verified.
rejectionReasons.solution: Obtain an intimation certificate signed by the attending midwife and village Sarpanch within 21 days.

rejectionReasons.title: Discrepancy Between Hospital Record and Application Date
rejectionReasons.description: Entering a date or time of birth different from the hospital discharge summary halts Registrar approval.
rejectionReasons.solution: Cross-check the exact date and hour of birth from the institutional discharge summary before submitting.

rejectionReasons.title: Uploading Unclear or Altered Hospital Discharge Slip
rejectionReasons.description: Scans with overwriting, corrections without doctor countersignature, or blurred stamps fail verification.
rejectionReasons.solution: Obtain a fresh computerized discharge summary from the hospital administration if alterations exist.

rejectionReasons.title: Duplicate Application for Already Registered Birth
rejectionReasons.description: Applying for a new registration when the hospital has already notified the Registrar creates an illegal duplicate entry.
rejectionReasons.solution: Search existing records on the portal using mother's name and hospital registration number instead of re-registering.

faqItems.question: Is birth registration free in India?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Registration within 21 days is 100% free, and the first certificate is provided free under Section 12.

faqItems.question: What is the deadline to register a birth in India?
faqItems.answer: Under the RBD Act 1969, a birth must be reported to the local Registrar within 21 days of occurrence.

faqItems.question: Can a birth certificate be issued without naming the child initially?
faqItems.answer: Yes. A birth certificate can be issued without a name, and parents can add the name later.

faqItems.question: Up to what age can the child's name be added to a birth certificate?
faqItems.answer: Parents can add the child's name within one year free of cost, and up to 15 years with a nominal fee.

faqItems.question: How can I register a birth after more than one year has passed?
faqItems.answer: You must obtain an inquiry order from an Executive Magistrate (SDM) under Section 13(3) of the Act.

faqItems.question: Can I download my birth certificate online?
faqItems.answer: Yes. If the birth was registered on the Civil Registration System, you can download the digitally signed certificate using OTP.

faqItems.question: Is the birth certificate mandatory for school admission and passport?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Under the 2023 Amendment Act, the digital birth certificate serves as the single document proving date and place of birth.

faqItems.question: What is the process for registering a child born at home?
faqItems.answer: The family head must inform the local Registrar within 21 days with an intimation slip from the attending midwife.

GJ.title: How to Get a Birth Certificate in Gujarat (2026)
GJ.summary: In Gujarat, births are registered online via e-Nagar across urban municipalities and through Talati-cum-Mantri at Gram Panchayats. Digital bilingual certificates are issued in Gujarati and English with verifiable QR codes.
GJ.verifiedBy: Civic Research Editorial Team - Gujarat Bureau

steps.title: Institutional Birth Reporting by Hospital in Gujarat
steps.description: Government or private hospitals in Gujarat report child deliveries electronically within 21 days to the local municipal ward or rural registrar.
steps.calloutText: Hospital staff generate official Form 1 discharge slips and transmit delivery records directly to municipal health databases.

steps.title: Register on Gujarat e-Nagar or Visit Gram Panchayat
steps.description: Urban residents access the official e-Nagar portal or municipal civic center. Rural residents visit their village Gram Panchayat Talati office.

steps.title: Submit Form 1 Details and Child Name Entry
steps.description: Provide child gender, date of birth, place of birth, parents' full names in Gujarati and English, and Aadhaar numbers.
steps.calloutText: Ensure accurate spelling in both Gujarati script and English to prevent future passport and school enrollment issues.

steps.title: Upload Hospital Discharge Card and Parents' ID Proofs
steps.description: Attach hospital birth discharge slip, parents' marriage proof or joint declaration, and self-attested copies of Aadhaar cards.

steps.title: Executive Magistrate Order for Delayed Registrations
steps.description: For births registered after one year, submit non-availability certificate Form 10 to obtain a statutory order from the Taluka Mamlatdar.
steps.calloutText: Under Section 13(3) of the RBD Act, births over one year old require formal magisterial sanction before registration.

steps.title: Download QR-Coded Bilingual Birth Certificate
steps.description: Once approved by the municipal health officer, download your digitally signed birth certificate from e-Nagar or collect it at the civic center.
steps.calloutText: Digital certificates feature embedded QR codes that can be scanned for instant authenticity verification anywhere.

fees.label: Timely Registration Fee (Within 21 Days)
fees.description: Statutory registration and first certified copy is free within 21 days of birth.

fees.label: Additional Certified Copy Fee
fees.description: Prescribed statutory charge per additional certified copy under Gujarat RBD Rules.

fees.label: Late Registration Penalty (After 30 Days)
fees.description: Statutory delayed registration fine prescribed under Gujarat state birth registration rules.

faqItems.question: Are Gujarat birth certificates issued in both Gujarati and English?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Gujarat generates standardized bilingual birth certificates displaying names in Gujarati and English scripts.

faqItems.question: How can I add my child's name to a Gujarat birth certificate later?
faqItems.answer: You can add the name online on e-Nagar within twelve months without fee, or up to fifteen years with nominal charge.

faqItems.question: What is the procedure for registering a birth after one year in Gujarat?
faqItems.answer: Apply to the Taluka Mamlatdar with an affidavit and school records to obtain an Executive Magistrate sanction order.

faqItems.question: Can I download an old birth certificate from Gujarat e-Nagar?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Search digitized municipal birth records by hospital, ward, and registration year on the e-Nagar portal.
